{{Quote|I owe you. If there's anything you need, let me know.|Vek Drow, to Qui-Gon Jinn|audio=VekDrow.flac|<ref name="Star Wars: Episode I The Phantom Menace (video game)">[[Star Wars: Episode I The Phantom Menace (video game)|''Star Wars'': Episode I ''The Phantom Menace'' video game]]</ref>}}
'''Vek Drow''' was an [[Ishi Tib/Legends|Ishi Tib]] merchant in [[Mos Espa/Legends|Mos Espa]] during the time of the [[Invasion of Naboo/Legends|Invasion of Naboo]], whose shop was rescued from a robbery by [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Qui-Gon Jinn/Legends|Qui-Gon Jinn]], who, while searching for a [[Hyperdrive/Legends|hyperdrive]] generator among the vendors, spotted Drow being attacked. Jinn swiftly defeated the two [[Rodian/Legends|Rodian]] thugs accosting Drow and was, in turn, given an [[engine binder]] when Jinn needed them to trade for parts that [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker]] needed to fix [[Anakin Skywalker's Podracer/Legends|his podracer]] in time for the [[Boonta Eve Classic/Legends|Boonta Eve Classic]] [[Podracing/Legends|podrace]].

==Behind the scenes==
After Drow gives the player the engine binder, he doesn't want to talk to Jinn again. Whenever the player tries to interact with Drow, he says he already gave the engine binder to Jinn. The player must acquire parts to repair the [[Podracer/Legends|podracer]] by completing side quests.
